description: This file defines the ComplexTensor class, a specialized subclass of torch.Tensor that handles complex numbers by decomposing operations into real and imaginary parts. It includes methods for construction, property access, dispatching custom operations, and conversion between interleaved and separate real-imaginary representations. The file also defines the Complex autograd Function facilitating forward and backward computations for complex tensors.
